translations.english: In the beginning Elokim created the heavens and the earth.
Now the earth was formless and empty, and darkness was over the surface of the deep, and the spirit of Elokim was hovering over the surface of the water.
And Elokim said, "Let there be light," and there was light.
And Elokim saw the light that it was good, and Elokim separated between the light and between the darkness.
And Elokim called the light day, and the darkness He called night, and it was evening and it was morning, one day.
And Elokim said, "Let there be an expanse in the midst of the water, and let it be a separation between water and water."
And Elokim made the expanse and it separated between the water that was below the expanse and the water that was above the expanse, and it was so.
And Elokim called the expanse Heaven, and it was evening and it was morning, a second day.
And Elokim said, "Let the water beneath the heavens be gathered into one place, and let the dry land appear," and it was so.
And Elokim called the dry land earth, and the gathering of the waters He called seas, and Elokim saw that it was good.
And Elokim said, "Let the earth sprout vegetation, seed bearing herbs and fruit trees producing fruit according to its kind, in which its seed is found, on the earth," and it was so.
And the earth gave forth vegetation, seed bearing herbs according to its kind, and trees producing fruit, in which its seed is found, according to its kind, and Elokim saw that it was good.
And it was evening and it was morning, a third day.

And Elokim said, "Let there be luminaries in the expanse of the heavens, to separate between the day and between the night, and they shall be for signs and for appointed seasons and for days and years.
And they shall be for luminaries in the expanse of the heavens to shed light upon the earth," and it was so.
And Elokim made the two great luminaries: the greater luminary to rule the day, and the lesser luminary to rule the night, and the stars.
And Elokim placed them in the expanse of the heavens to shed light upon the earth.
And to rule over the day and over the night, and to separate between the light and between the darkness, and Elokim saw that it was good.
And it was evening and it was morning, a fourth day.
And Elokim said, "Let the waters swarm a swarming of living creatures, and let fowl fly over the earth across the expanse of the heavens."

And Elokim created the great sea monsters, and every living creature that crawls, with which the waters swarmed according to their kind, and every winged fowl according to its kind, and Elokim saw that it was good.
And Elokim blessed them, saying, "Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let the fowl multiply upon the earth."
And it was evening and it was morning, a fifth day.
And Elokim said, "Let the earth bring forth living creatures according to their kind, cattle and creeping things and the beasts of the earth according to their kind," and it was so.

And Elokim made the beasts of the earth according to their kind and the cattle according to their kind, and all the creeping things of the ground according to their kind, and Elokim saw that it was good.

And Elokim said, "Let us make man in our image, after our likeness, and let them rule over the fish of the sea and over the fowl of the heaven and over the animals and over all the earth and over all the creeping things that creep upon the earth."
And Elokim created man in His image; in the image of Elokim He created him; male and female He created them.

And Elokim blessed them, and Elokim said to them, "Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth and subdue it, and rule over the fish of the sea and over the fowl of the sky and over all the living creatures that crawl upon the earth."
And Elokim said, "Behold, I have given you every seed bearing herb, which is upon the surface of the entire earth, and every tree that has seed bearing fruit in it; it will be yours for food.
And to every beast of the earth and to every fowl of the heavens and to everything that moves upon the earth, in which there is a living creature, every green herb for food," and it was so.
And Elokim saw all that He had made, and behold it was very good, and it was evening and it was morning, the sixth day.
